name: add-to-cart-button
title: Add to cart button
description: The buy button with its commerce states: select an option, adding, added with View cart, failed with retry, sold out and pre-order.
docs: onAdd may return a promise: the button is busy until it settles, says Added beside a View cart link, or shows an inline error that retries. Pass missingOption while a variant is unchosen, soldOut with onNotify for Notify me, preorder for a ship date, or drive it with status.
